newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - January 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - January 20.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Monday's edition of Daily Variety:
* CBS paid more than $3 million for the broadcast rights to 53rd Presidential Inaugural Gala held Sunday at U.S. Air Arena.

* Winners at the 54th annual Golden Globes included actresses Madonna and Lauren Bacall, movies "The English Patient" for best drama picture and "Evita" for best musical, which also won for the song "You Must Love Me," by Andrew Lloyd Webber and Tim Rice.

* Sony's TriStar Pictures' Beverly Hills Ninja and Buena Vista's Metro were deadlocked Sunday in their box office draw on Martin Luther King Jr day weekend. Sony Pictures projected Ninja would bring in $10 million during the Friday-Sunday period, while Buena Vista predicted $9.3 million for Metro.
